decisions: The residue is the top of the DAG, not the bottom. extract_modules refuses any new module that reads a residue unit, so the map's shape (delivery_eligibility keeps the facts and the four new files read them) is a back-edge five times over. Inverted: the shared vocabulary moves down into delivery_facts.py and delivery_classes.py, and delivery_eligibility.py keeps the decision the file is named for, SourceSelection, DeliveryAcceptance, DefenseEligibility and EligibilityDecision. That is the roster's defense_eligibility.py, living on under the existing file name; renaming the residue is not something this tool does.

The two decision paths do split, against the file-length-ok reason at L57. The spell shield half reads DefenseWindow, _attacker_name, UseBudget and FullBlockRule and reads none of DefenseEligibility, EligibilityDecision, SourceSelection or DeliveryAcceptance, so it is strictly below the residue and can move; keeping both halves in one file leaves 673 lines against sightline #27's 500.

DefenseWindow and _attacker_name go to delivery_facts.py rather than staying with the acceptance half: the spell shield reads both, and a 30-line module for the two of them would be a slice, not a concept.
SPELL_SHIELD_REARM_RULE moves with SpellShieldRearmClock. Left in spell_shield_eligibility.py it closes a cycle, because the clock reads the rule and the receipt reads the clock.
stable_event_key moves down with the facts it reads. Its 34 reference sites repoint to delivery_facts.

BLOCKED on a tool defect, not on this shape. extract_modules refuses defense_composition.py with 'unresolved: reads each_eligible / first_eligible / per_cast / none / first, bound nowhere': module_units._annotation_names parses every string constant in an annotation as a forward reference, so UseBudget's consume: Literal['first_eligible', 'each_eligible', 'per_cast'] and FullBlockRule's mode: Literal['none', 'first', 'all'] read as six names. The fix is to skip string constants under a Literal[...] subscript. With that patch this assignment checks clean: five modules, an acyclic graph, a 330-line residue and 92 reader sites. No arrangement of units avoids it, because the two units refuse wherever they land, and every clean-today variant leaves the residue over sightline #27's 500.
Run this assignment and cleanse_eligibility.json one after the other, never in parallel: cleanse_declarations.py reads PacketIdentity, which this move takes to delivery_facts.py.
Published spelling: delivery_classes' _action_flag is action_flag, read by the residue and by spell_shield_eligibility.
